This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. 🌿 5-Minute Dump & Bake Chicken Pesto A ridiculously easy one-pan dinner that tastes fancy but takes almost no effort. If you’ve got 5 minutes, a jar of pesto, and some chicken, dinner is basically done. This dump-and-bake pesto chicken turns juicy, cheesy, and flavorful with almost zero prep — just season, spread, and bake. 🍗 Ingredients 	•	4 chicken breasts 	•	Salt & pepper 	•	Garlic powder 	•	Oregano 	•	1 jar pesto 	•	6–8 slices mozzarella cheese Optional toppings (highly recommended): 	•	Fresh tomato slices 	•	Fresh basil 	•	Balsamic glaze 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Prep (takes about 5 minutes) Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish or sheet pan. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and oregano. 2️⃣ Dump the pesto Spread a spoonful of pesto over each chicken breast, then dump the rest of the jar around the chicken so everything bakes in that garlicky goodness. 3️⃣ Bake Bake at 400°F for about 30 minutes. Cooking time may vary depending on the thickness of the chicken. Chicken is ready when it reaches 165°F internal temperature. 4️⃣ Add the cheese Top each chicken breast with sliced mozzarella. 5️⃣ Melt & finish Return to the oven and bake or broil for 10–15 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly. ✨ Optional Finishing Touch Top with fresh tomato slices, basil, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze for a caprese-style upgrade.

Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

Easy one-pot chicken broccoli Alfredo pasta 🍗🥦🍝 recipe below & follow for more easy meal ideas! . The dinner I make when I don’t feel like cooking but still want something delicious that the whole family will love! ❤️ This creamy, cheesy chicken Alfredo pasta is made in one skillet with protein penne, tender chicken, fresh broccoli, and a creamy Parmesan sauce 🤤 . Ingredients: -1 tbsp olive oil -1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, diced into bite-size pieces -Salt and black pepper, to taste -Garlic powder, to taste -Paprika, to taste -Italian seasoning, to taste -1 tbsp minced garlic -1 package protein penne pasta -3 cups low-sodium chicken broth -1 cup half-and-half, plus an extra splash if desired -2 heads broccoli, cut into small florets -½–¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese . 1. Heat olive oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat. Add diced chicken and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Cook for a few minutes, stirring, until browned on all sides. 2. Make a little space in the skillet and add minced garlic. Cook for about 30 seconds, then stir everything together. 3. Add protein penne, chicken broth, half-and-half, and another sprinkle of the seasonings. Stir well and press the pasta beneath the liquid. 4. Bring to a simmer, cover, and reduce the heat to low-medium. Cook for 7–8 minutes, stirring as needed to prevent sticking. 5. Add broccoli florets and stir them into the pasta. Cover again and cook for another 5–6 minutes, or until the pasta is tender and the broccoli is cooked to your liking. 6. Uncover and stir everything together. Add the Parmesan cheese and mix until creamy. Add an extra splash of half-and-half if you’d like a creamier sauce. If needed, add a little extra broth to loosen the sauce. 7. Serve warm and enjoy! 🤗 . #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #foodtiktok #foodie #fyp @Caraway Home @barilla

✨Chicken Casserole ✨ Sometimes you just need a comforting, one-pan dinner that makes the whole house smell amazing. This chicken casserole is rustic, simple, and loaded with tender chicken, veggies, and a delicious sauce with wine and herbs. Perfect for a wholesome midweek dinner or make ahead as even better the next day 👌🏻 ⸻ Ingredients • 4 chicken breasts • 3 carrots chopped • 2 celery stalks • 1 large onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 3 medium potatoes, peeled and diced • 2 tbsp plain flour • 250 ml white wine • 500 ml chicken stock • 1 tsp dried thyme •. 1 tsp parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil or butter • Salt & black pepper, to taste ⸻ Instructions 1. Brown the chicken – Heat the olive oil or butter in a heavy casserole dish. Season the chicken with salt and pepper, then sear until lightly golden. Remove and set aside. 2. Soften the veggies – In the same pan, sauté the onion, carrots, celery, garlic, for about 5 minutes until they begin to soften. 3. Make the base – Sprinkle over the flour and stir well. Pour in the wine, letting it bubble for a minute as you scrape up all the tasty browned bits. 4. Add stock & herbs – Stir in the chicken stock, thyme, and return the chicken to the dish. Add on potatoes. Bring to a simmer. 5. Slow cook – Cover and cook gently on the stovetop for 35–40 minutes until the chicken is tender and the potatoes are cooked through. 6. Finish & serve – Adjust seasoning with extra salt and pepper if needed. ⸻ Serve hot with crusty bread to mop up the sauce. #chickencasserole #comfortfood #cosy #irishcooking #chickendinner

These 4 ingredient crock pot ranch chicken make busy nights so much easier 🐔🧈 Dump it in the slow cooker in the morning, and dinner is done when you walk in the door, friend! Ingredients: 🍗 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts 🥣 1 packet dry ranch mix 🥣 ½ cup chicken broth 🧈 1 stick butter Steps: 1️⃣ Place chicken breasts in the bottom of the slow cooker 2️⃣ Sprinkle ranch seasoning evenly over the chicken 3️⃣ Pour chicken broth over the chicken 4️⃣ Place the butter on top 5️⃣ Cover and cook on low 4-6 hours or high 3-4 hours, until chicken reaches 165°F 6️⃣ Shred with two forks and stir it into all those buttery juices 7️⃣ Serve warm over mashed potatoes, rice, or on buns! 🙌 #crockpotranchchicken #crockpotrecipes #slowcooker #easydinner #4ingredientrecipe
